source: Original 1647 William Lilly Christian Astrology Wellcome b30338724
heading: Of the unity or concord of the Native with his Brethren and Sisters
scope: Historical claims about relational harmony/conflict only; no independently established social, criminal or financial prediction.

groups.group: Heading; lords of first and third, favorable, hard, or absent aspect

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXX Of the unity or concord ... Brethren and Sisters
claims.historical_meaning: Printed CXΧ begins original PDF601 as its own chapter after the sibling-condition chapter on PDF600.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent aspect ... Lord of the first and third
claims.historical_meaning: A favorable aspect between first-house and third-house lords is the principal asserted sign of harmony.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: concord and mutuall good will amongst them
claims.historical_meaning: The author links that aspect to mutual goodwill between native and siblings, without observed verification.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Square or Opposition happen betwixt them
claims.historical_meaning: A square or opposition between those lords is presented as a contrary sibling relationship condition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: there's no signe of concord
claims.historical_meaning: For a hard first/third lord aspect Lilly assigns discord, without a specific frequency threshold.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: if no aspect at all happen
claims.historical_meaning: The author explicitly considers absence of any aspect as a third case, different from a hard aspect.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: no love is like to be
claims.historical_meaning: A no-aspect branch is said to foretell low affection, a historical speculation, not an actual relationship fact.

groups.group: Extension to kin, neighbors and unverified confidence claim

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: may be applied to Kinred, Neighbours, or Consanguinity
claims.historical_meaning: The same hypothetical family-concord rubric is extended to kin and neighbors, widening its possible matching scope.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: I usually doe find ... do not remember ... ever failed
claims.historical_meaning: Lilly claims high personal success without presenting independent case counts, misses or blinded checks.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn Peregrine in the third
claims.historical_meaning: Peregrine Saturn in the third is among several original conditions alleged to disturb family relations.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Mars ... posited therein
claims.historical_meaning: Mars in the third is presented as an alternative to peregrine Saturn; exact dignity requirements differ.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or South Node posited therein
claims.historical_meaning: South lunar node in the third is an additional alternative indicator, source glyph requiring independent study.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: many unkindnesses, much controversie ... disturbed
claims.historical_meaning: Lilly alleges unexpected family disputes and disruption under those conditions, not demonstrated on independent people.

groups.group: Ascendant lord with malefic hard aspects

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the ascendant in Square ... Saturn or Mars
claims.historical_meaning: First-house ruler square Saturn or Mars is an alleged negative sibling bond condition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Opposition of Saturn or Mars
claims.historical_meaning: Opposition is listed as a separate unfavorable alternative, not interchangeable with conjunction.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or both
claims.historical_meaning: Either one or both malefics may apply, creating overlapping source conditions.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: but little love ... amongst the Brethren
claims.historical_meaning: The combined malefic-aspect condition is assigned weak affection within the sibling group.

groups.group: Mars as third ruler; trine, reception and distinct intersibling condition

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: If the Lord of the third be Mars
claims.historical_meaning: This favorable exception starts with Mars as third ruler; Mars alone in third does not suffice.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: behold Lord of the ascendant with a Trine
claims.historical_meaning: The third-ruling Mars must form a trine to the Ascendant ruler, a separate exact aspect requirement.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: and by Reception
claims.historical_meaning: Reception is an additional requirement of the Mars-based favorable exception.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Native shall agree well with his Brethren
claims.historical_meaning: The author allows agreement between native and siblings despite Mars's malefic status, reversing naive Mars-only logic.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: though they dissent amongst themselves
claims.historical_meaning: The positive native-sibling relation can coexist with sibling-sibling discord; distinguish the relational dyads.

groups.group: Third ruler at ascendant, reception or same ruler

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the third in the ascendant
claims.historical_meaning: The third ruler in the first house is offered as one possible favorable relation condition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: agreeing with the Lord of the ascendant
claims.historical_meaning: Agreement between third and first lord is a favorable qualification rather than mere house occupancy.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or in mutuall Reception
claims.historical_meaning: Mutual reception is separately listed as an alternative condition for sibling harmony.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: one Planet Lord of the third and first
claims.historical_meaning: The same planet ruling both houses is another distinct proposed route, not simultaneously required with reception.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: great concord betwixt the Native and his Brethren
claims.historical_meaning: The preceding configurations allegedly imply substantial harmony, without any human-outcome test.

groups.group: Kinship benefits and harms through third lord Fortune and second lord

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the third be joyned to Part of Fortune or his Lord
claims.historical_meaning: Lilly requires the third ruler conjunct Part of Fortune or its lord for an alleged gain from siblings or kin.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: in good places of Heaven
claims.historical_meaning: The Fortune configuration is further conditioned on placement in favorable houses.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: benefit and profit ... Brethren or Sisters or Kinred
claims.historical_meaning: The author alleges economic advantage from relatives, not independently documented financial transfers.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: South Node in the third
claims.historical_meaning: The inverse harm case begins with South Node located in the third house.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the second Combust
claims.historical_meaning: The economic-harm case additionally specifies combustion of second-house ruler.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: receive prejudice ... Brethren ... Estate
claims.historical_meaning: The compound source condition is claimed to lead to financial harm from siblings, not evidence against actual kin.

groups.group: Three ascending-sign groups and Mercury-Mars opposition

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Aries or Libra in the first
claims.historical_meaning: Aries or Libra rising is associated with unfavorable sibling description in this source.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Brethren poor conditioned, or else enemies
claims.historical_meaning: Lilly presents poverty/hostility alternatives for that rising-sign group without measuring outcomes.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Cancer or Scorpio ... first
claims.historical_meaning: Cancer or Scorpio rising is described as signifying powerful relatives in the historical account.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: powerfull Kinred ... not helpfull, rather enemies
claims.historical_meaning: The seemingly beneficial powerful-relatives signal is explicitly paired with lack of aid or hostility.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Leo or Aquarius in the first
claims.historical_meaning: Leo or Aquarius rising is a third original sign-group condition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Brethren either dissent, or stir up trouble
claims.historical_meaning: Lilly associates that pair with disagreements or trouble from siblings, with no independent verification.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury in Opposition to Mars
claims.historical_meaning: A Mercury–Mars opposition is named as another distinct purported signal of disagreement.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: notes disagreement
claims.historical_meaning: The Mercury–Mars contact is said to imply disagreement, without defining time or persons.

groups.group: General kin/neighbors scope and following separate numbered chapter

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: What is spoke of Brethren, understand of Kinred and Neighbours
claims.historical_meaning: The author explicitly extends his sibling concord descriptions to kin and neighbors, increasing interpretation flexibility.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXI Number of Brethren
claims.historical_meaning: Printed CXXI begins at top original PDF602 and is a separate demographic question; navigation only.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Take that from the Signe of the third house
claims.historical_meaning: Only the first phrase of CXXI is witnessed here; substantive claims in CXXI are not admitted to CXX.
